Method of Attack: Exploiting zero-day unauthenticated stored XSS vulnerabilities to create rogue administrator accounts and plant backdoors
Impacted Systems: Flexible Checkout Fields for WooCommerce plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day and unpatched plugin vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Appearance of new admin accounts not created by site owner
Suspicious files with .php or .zip extensions in /wp-content/uploads/ directory (e.g., Woo-Add-To-Carts.zip)
Rearrangement or faulty functioning of checkout fields
